sources.note: Nothing: gives 19 consonants (Table 1), 5 short vowels (Table 2), /v/ [v~f] and [j] as allophone of /i/; no statement on stress, accent or prosody.

sources.citation: François, Alexandre. 2021. Teanu dictionary (Vanikoro, Solomon Islands). Dictionaria 15. Introduction, sect. 6.2 Phonology (pp. 10-11).
sources.note: For TEANU (not Tanema): 'Stress regularly hits the penultimate syllable of a phonological word: Teanu [teˈanu]... vesepiene [ˌfesepiˈene] 'word'; basakulumoe [ˌᵐbasakuluˈmoe] 'island'.' Lovono/Tanema appear only as lexical equivalents; no prosodic statement about them.
